test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The villain of the play was hated by the audience.

options.text: The audience hated the villain of the play.
The villain hated the audience of the play.
The audience had hated the villain of the play.
The audience was hating the villain of the play.

solution:
The correct answer is- **"****The audience hated the villain of the play"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence satisfies the structure of Passive Voice: Object + was/were+V3+by+Subject.
 
• In the given options, **"The audience hated the villain of the play" **is the most appropriate expression that denotes active voice.
